description: Adds another phone number to a contact, as the contact card's Add phone does. It joins the contact's identity so an inbound text or call from it lands here and search finds the contact by it. A number another contact holds, or one of the business's own lines, is refused with who holds it. makeTextNumber makes it the number Sergio texts; the contact's first number does that by default. Pass the same idempotency_key when retrying; a repeat changes only its label.

idempotency_key.description: Your id for this operation (8-128 of A-Z a-z 0-9 . _ : -). Reuse it on every retry of the same operation; use a new one for a new operation.

name: add_client_identifier
title: Add a phone number to a contact
